common.get_status_rhythm: stage-transition + before-long-command + after-edit + before-finalize (shared A0/B/C; C adds soft-close decision only)

heldout_note: heldout 28 (26 snapshot groups: FastAPI13/Rich11/Requests4) frozen until final freeze; any early use must be logged as exposed, no longer independent
note: A0 is revised common baseline (differs from 001); 001 kept as history only, not strict paired control. B=A0+no-progress; C=B+20s soft close. Six tasks x three variants = 18 runs, ABC orders balanced, cold/hot cache recorded. Panel 24 (12/8/4) paired only after exploration picks at most one candidate.

panel.pairing: A0-first vs candidate-first 12/12, balanced within repo; first full panel is primary; no post-hoc cherry-picked reruns merged into mean

repeats.attempt: per-task retry gets new attempt id AND new actual results_dir (official filenames contain only task id)
repeats.repeat_id: full batch rerun uses new repeat dir; never overwrite; manifest references attempt originals

a0.desc: common-revised baseline: evidence-only edits, no temp files in diff, registered-tools only, overlap reread on truncation, submit-then-stop

b.desc: A0 + no-progress identification (adjacent + short-loop, 2-repeat trigger) and direction switch

c.desc: B + 20s soft close-out (review diff and submit; no unfounded edits)
